MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The smart plug feels like a useful next step because it would add voice control to a lamp alongside my existing Alexa-enabled equipment.",
    "The Echo Show fits my interest in home viewing and security because its screen adds a new use: home controls and potentially viewing compatible cameras."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The HD and older Fire TV sticks duplicate something my 4K stick and Fire TV television already do, without giving me a clear additional benefit.",
    "Earbuds and car-based Alexa do not address my current home equipment needs, while the 16TB drive offers more storage than I have a clear use for.",
    "Another camera is relevant to my interests, but I would use my Foscam and Blink cameras before adding a separate camera system."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning Alexa-enabled devices seems to have been taken as a reason to suggest Alexa products for any setting, including my car.",
    "My streaming and camera purchases seem to have been treated as reasons to buy more devices with the same functions, even when those functions are already covered."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "What matters now is whether a device adds a useful capability to my existing home setup rather than repeats one I already have.",
    "The Echo Show's screen gives me a reason to choose it over an Echo Dot; shared voice features alone do not make them equally useful to me.",
    "My recording history makes storage plausible, but it does not establish that I currently need a very large external drive."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognized my connected-home interests but missed the difference between useful additions and equipment that duplicates what I already own."
}
